body.title: Reconcile explicit classifications and exact inventory checks
body.summary: Reconcile missing rows in src/daemon/repo-call-audit.ts and src/daemon/threads/method-class.ts against current callable handlers and phase schemas. Class qualificationState as unary session/read-only; retain retired-review no-work boundary and explicit main-daemon overrides. Replace regex-only registration discovery and filename-only phase inference in the audit/table tests with independent constructed runtime and callable-contract inventories. Preserve the upstream handler snapshot fix. Strengthen method-class drift and explicit retired-review ownership checks. Replace the unfinished early tools.call repository check with daemon-supplied final admission in the existing executor after its prior lookup/schema/cancellation/approval-denial paths, before capability execution and successful hooks. Keep existing RPC parameter/result schemas.
acceptanceChecks: qualificationState has an evidenced read-only audit entry and unary ordinary session class; it is absent from shared-state and FIFO-exempt sets.
design-review-step.cancel and any other callable phase omissions receive evidence-based classifications, with no stale phase rows or deleted review execution restored.

No IPC parameter/result schema, storage schema, repo fallback or worker runtime import change. Previously unaudited modifying team RPCs and otherwise admitted tools.call gain intentional registered-repo refusals under the revised LLD.
Audits exactly cover the merged RPC/stream maps and callable phases, with valid evidence and disjoint modifying/nonmodifying partition.
Independent negative controls fail for missing/stale/unknown keys, duplicate classification entries and wrong stream flags; no blanket family exemptions.
Upstream handler snapshot additions remain intact; full handler-runtime file passes without regenerating expected keys from the table under test.
Retired-review ownership checks use the exact main-daemon override sets and current router precedence; supported shared-state families still route correctly.
Unknown tool, existing input-schema rejection, cancellation and approval denial preserve their exact prior ToolResult/envelopes and perform no repository lookup.
The daemon alone supplies the internal tools.call admission dependency; no wire callback or bypass is accepted. Other executeTool callers retain their existing contracts.

Immediately before capability execution, an invalid/unregistered repo yields an unsuccessful ToolResult with the existing repo refusal code in its error text; neither capability execution nor successful hooks run.
An admitted call with a valid registered repo executes with canonical repoPath and preserves its successful result/done shape. Recheck cancellation if an asynchronous authority lookup was in flight.
Retain explicit registration/phase metadata and real retired-review router precedence tests, and rerun the full mapped files before resubmitting task one.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/repo-call-audit.test.ts — exact constructed RPC/stream and callable phase coverage; valid evidence and repo rules; missing/stale negative controls.
src/daemon/__tests__/repo-call-table.test.ts — exact disjoint table partition and unknown-name control.
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/method-class.test.ts — exact classes/transport, duplicates and drift, explicit retired ownership, worker-safe imports.
src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts — retain reviewed upstream snapshot additions and full runtime construction coverage.

src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-handler.test.ts and src/daemon/tools/__tests__/executor.test.ts — preserve earlier unknown/schema/cancellation/approval-denial results without registry lookup; enforce final admission, canonical registered success, no execution/hooks on refusal, and cancellation during authority lookup.

src/daemon/tools/__tests__/executor-approval.test.ts and src/daemon/tools/__tests__/executor-abort.test.ts — existing approval and abort contracts remain unchanged after adding tools.call final authority admission.
src/daemon/__tests__/review-retirement-endpoints.test.ts and src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-retirement-runtime.test.ts — retired review no-work responses and local ownership remain intact.
